texte.Indicateurs de pilotage de la conformité: AI compliance steering indicators, including sector-specific KPIs
texte.Indice de conformité RGPD constaté pour: GDPR compliance index observed for this client (#–#, required threshold:
texte.Indiquer ses coordonnées et conserver le: Provide its contact details and keep the documents
texte.Indirectement — responsabilité de vérifi: Indirectly — the responsibility for verification lies with the ordering party
texte.Indispensable pour un déploiement hors d: Essential for a deployment outside France.
texte.Industrie manufacturière, automobile, aé: Manufacturing industry, automotive, aeronautics, chemicals and capital goods.
texte.Information claire aux utilisateurs inte: Clear information to users interacting with an AI (Art. #(#))
texte.Information claire que l'utilisateur int: Clear information that the user is interacting with an AI (Art. #(#)). Applicable on # August #.
texte.Information de la personne : sait-elle q: Information of the person: do they know that a score concerns them?
texte.Information, droit à l'explication, cont: Information, right to an explanation, effective human oversight: automated filtering that leaves no trace of the reason is indefensible, and will be so before a judge before it is before the regulator.
texte.Informations incorrectes, incomplètes ou: Incorrect, incomplete or misleading information — Art. #(#)
texte.Informer explicitement les salariés avan: Explicitly inform employees before any deployment — the combined AI Act + GDPR + employment law regime makes this case particularly exposed to legal challenges.
texte.Informer l'utilisateur des voies de reco: Inform the user of the available means of redress
texte.Informer le notifiant de la décision pri: Inform the notifier of the decision taken
texte.Informer les personnes soumises à une dé: Inform the persons subject to a decision
texte.Informer les utilisateurs qu'ils interag: Inform users that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the context.
texte.Informer les utilisateurs que le contenu: Inform users that the content is personalised by AI (Art. #(#)). Manipulation exploiting psychological vulnerabilities: prohibited, Art. #(#)(a). Social scoring systems: prohibited, Art. #(#)(c).
texte.Informer sans délai toute la chaîne (dis: Inform the whole chain without delay (distributors, deployers, authorised representative, importers)
texte.Infrastructures critiques (Annexe III po: Critical infrastructure (Annex III, point #) — exempted from the FRIA by Art. #(#)(a), unless the deployer is a public body providing a public service in the broad sense.
texte.Inscrire les systèmes d’IA avant d’en pe: Record the AI systems before weighing a single one
texte.Inscrivez le système avec son fournisseu: Record the system with its provider, its purpose, its input data and the actual hosting region.
texte.Inscrivez le système dès le PoC, avec sa: Record the system from the PoC stage, with its purpose, its model provider and its data.
texte.Inscrivez le système et rattachez-lui, d: Record the system and link to it, at this stage, the family it belongs to if you produce several similar ones.
texte.Inscrivez les systèmes d’IA à inclure, a: Record the AI systems to include, with their model, their volumes, and fine-tuning where a training campaign took place.
texte.Installer le relais qui fait tenir l'usa: Put in place the relay that keeps usage going between two training sessions — and know how to recognise that it is not holding.
texte.Institutions et organes de l'Union, orga: Union institutions and bodies, intergovernmental organisations, diplomatic and consular missions.
texte.Instruire un dossier de financement de p: Assess a project finance file or an underwriting: what the reference framework attests, what it estimates, and what will have to be measured in the data room.
texte.Instruire une aide sociale — APA, PCH —: Processing social assistance — APA, PCH — on behalf of a local authority brings you within Annex III, point # a). The point expressly covers the assessment of eligibility and the granting, reduction or revocation of benefits.
texte.Intensité carbone appliquée à la consomm: Carbon intensity applied to the estimated consumption. Each value carries its NATURE: published, site (announced capacity) or class (order of magnitude of the category).
texte.Interdiction de concevoir des interfaces: Prohibition on designing interfaces intended to deceive or manipulate users in their decisions.
texte.Interdiction de l'auto-préférence, oblig: Prohibition of self-preferencing, interoperability obligation, prohibition on combining personal data across services without consent.
texte.Interdire un outil déplace l’usage hors: Prohibiting a tool moves its use out of your sight. What can be steered is what is allowed, and the way it is checked.
texte.Interdit # catégories de pratiques : (a): Prohibits # categories of practices: (a) subliminal manipulation, (b) exploitation of vulnerabilities, (c) social scoring by public authorities, (d) predictive policing through individual profiling, (e) facial databases built by scraping, (f) emotion inference in the workplace/education, (g) biometric categorisation using sensitive data, (h) real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces (except for strict exceptions).
texte.Interfaces homme-machine permettant la s: Human-machine interfaces enabling effective oversight. Operators able to understand the capabilities and limitations of the system, detect anomalies, and disregard or interrupt the system.
texte.Interfaces permettant la compréhension d: Interfaces enabling competent operators to understand the outputs, interrupt or correct the system.
texte.Interroger les achats et l'IT sur les op: Ask purchasing and IT about the AI options already enabled in SaaS contracts.
texte.Intragroupe, ou ne servant que des entit: Intragroup, or serving only entities of a single Member State: designation is impossible, whatever the market share.
texte.Intégrateur — je modifie substantielleme: Integrator — I substantially modify a product already on the market
texte.Intégrer la cybersécurité dès la phase d: Build cybersecurity in from the design phase
texte.Intégrer les fournisseurs IA (cloud, mod: Include AI providers (cloud, third-party models, APIs) in the register of ICT service providers
texte.Intégrer les risques spécifiques à l'IA: Integrate AI-specific risks into the DPIA (bias, opacity, data quality)
texte.Intégrer les systèmes IA dans la cartogr: Include AI systems in the entity’s cyber risk mapping
texte.Intégrez un jalon de conformité obligato: Build a mandatory compliance milestone in before each release to production.
texte.Inventaire des traitements au sens de l': Inventory of processing activities within the meaning of Article #.
texte.Inventaire et documentation technique (a: Inventory and technical documentation (art. #, Annex IV).
texte.Inventaire exigé par le règlement, conse: Inventory required by the Regulation, kept in the database and isolated per client. The module does NOT offer an export button: the printable document comes from the audit report, at the next step.
texte.Inventaire obligatoire (Art. #, #) de vo: Mandatory inventory (Art. #, #) of your AI systems, connected to a real persistent database (not a demo).
texte.Inventoriez ce que vous assemblez, compo: Inventory what you assemble, component by component, with its versions.
texte.Irritants prioritaires identifiés ; sati: Priority pain points identified; measurable satisfaction.
texte.Jalon ayant fait l’objet d’une double vé: Milestone that has undergone double verification (Sentinel score reached and documentary validation). Statements made under Articles L.#-# of the Code de commerce [Commercial Code] and # nonies A of Annex II to the CGI [General Tax Code].
texte.Je conçois ou fais concevoir ce produit: I design this product or have it designed
texte.Je le mets sur le marché sous MON nom ou: I place it on the market under MY name or MY brand
texte.Je le mets à disposition sans l’avoir co: I make it available without having designed or imported it
texte.Je suis soumis à NIS # — # me sert-elle: I am subject to NIS # — is # of use to me?
texte.Jeux de données d'entraînement, validati: Training, validation and testing datasets subject to appropriate governance practices: design choices, data collection and origin, preparation procedures, examination of possible biases.
texte.Joignez toujours la couverture au montan: Always attach the coverage to the amount. A total without its scope turns against whoever presents it.
texte.Journalisation automatique de chaque uti: Automatic logging of each use of the system (Art. #(#))
texte.Journalisation et boite noire des decisi: Logging and black box for automated decisions
texte.Journaux de connexion de l’outil, sur qu: Connection logs of the tool, over four rolling weeks, measured against the named list of recipients. A one-off extraction the day after a training session measures nothing.
texte.Journaux officiels, sources sectorielles: Official journals, sector sources, regulatory scope.
texte.Juridictions a risque critique : # - Jur: Jurisdictions at critical risk: # - Stable jurisdictions: # - Under active watch:
texte.Jusqu'à #% CA mondial/jour (astreinte): Up to #% of worldwide turnover/day (periodic penalty payment)
Justify the scope selected in writing. A restricted scope without justification is the first point an authority will attack.
texte.J’ai lu cet écran — bloc suivant ↓: I have read this screen — next block ↓
texte.J’y apporte une modification substantiel: I make a substantial modification to it
texte.KPIs des # blocs (EU / US / CN): KPIs of the # blocs (EU / US / CN)
texte.L IA Act et le RGPD se chevauchent sans: The AI Act and the GDPR overlap without merging — this pa
texte.L applicabilité est calculée automatique: Applicability is calculated automatically per system according to your sector. If applicable, answer the questionnaire on the # fundamental rights — the score updates in real time.
The import is taking longer than expected. The document may be large — check the list in a few moments; it should appear once processed.
texte.L onglet Veille qualifiée affiche un sco: The Qualified watch tab displays a personalised impact score (high/medium/low). The FR/EN filter limits the sources by language. The Notify button sends an email alert on high impacts.
texte.L utilisateur coche lui-meme son niveau: The user ticks their own compliance level. No documentary check or evidence is requested in this version.
texte.L'IA Act nomme expressément les organes: The AI Act expressly names the Union bodies
texte.L'accès aux données est restreint aux pe: Access to data is restricted to authorised persons by default
texte.L'annexe I, point # nomme l'administrati: Annex I, point # names the public administration of the Member States, central and regional. An intergovernmental organisation is not in it.
texte.L'annexe II, point # nomme les fournisse: Annex II, point # names providers of social networking services platforms. A theatre, a club or a publisher is not in it.
texte.L'annexe II, point # nomme les prestatai: Annex II, point # names providers of postal services, including courier services. A logistics activity in this section tips over that way.
texte.L'annexe II, point # nomme les « organis: Annex II, point # names “research organisations”. A design office that is not one is not caught by this route; an R&D centre is.
texte.L'annexe II, point # pour la distributio: Annex II, point # for the wholesale distribution of food; Annex II, point # for providers of online marketplaces. A non-food retailer without a marketplace is caught by neither.
texte.L'annexe II, point # vise la distributio: Annex II, point # covers WHOLESALE distribution and INDUSTRIAL production or processing of food. A farm is not in it; a processing plant or a wholesale trader is. The boundary is read in the text; it is not guessed.
texte.L'annexe II, point # vise le gros et la: Annex II, point # covers wholesale and industrial processing: a restaurant or a central kitchen for a local authority that serves directly does not come under it.
texte.L'annexe III les cite aux points # et #: Annex III cites them in points # and # — “Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, or on their behalf”. They are not out of scope: they are designated in it.
texte.L'annexe III, point # a) vise les systèm: Annex III, point # a) covers systems used BY judicial authorities. Advice to the client is not in it — but the same output, put before the court, commits the professional.
texte.L'annexe III, point # b) vise l'évaluati: Annex III, point # b) covers creditworthiness assessment and credit scoring — except fraud detection, which is expressly excluded. A retailer that offers payment in instalments comes under it.
texte.L'annexe III, point # vise cette section: Annex III, point # hits this section head-on
texte.L'appariement et la planification touche: Matching and scheduling touch Annex III, point #
texte.L'article # de la directive #/# admet la: Article # of Directive #/# allows mining unless expressly reserved by the rights holder. Training or fine-tuning on a catalogue requires checking this reservation, work by work if necessary.
texte.L'article # est le régime principal du s: Article # is the sector’s main regime
texte.L'article # transfère les obligations du: Article # transfers the provider’s obligations to whoever places a high-risk system on the market under their own name, or substantially modifies it. An integrator becomes a provider without having wanted to.
texte.L'article ne joue que si les trois sont: The Article only applies if all three are met. It is therefore enough for a single one to be missing for it to be ruled out — and that is exactly where litigation is played out.
texte.L'engin devient le point d'entrée: The machine becomes the entry point
texte.L'enjeu n'est pas seulement d'avoir un h: The issue is not only having a human “in the loop”. You must be able to demonstrate that they understand, re-examine and can change the decision.
texte.L'entreprise est-elle fournisseur, déplo: Is the company a provider, a deployer, or both? → Direct impact on the level of obligation.
texte.L'export a échoué. Réessayez dans un ins: The export failed. Try again in a moment.
texte.L'extraction n'est pas nommée ; le pétro: Extraction is not named; oil and gas are
texte.L'immunité ne remonte pas la chaîne: Immunity does not travel up the chain
texte.L'inférence n'est pas cochée : le systèm: Inference is not ticked: the system does not infer from its inputs how to generate its outputs. Software that runs rules written by a person does not fall within the definition, and the Regulation does not apply to it — neither high-risk, nor transparency, nor penalties. The classification below is given for information only; it is this question that must be decided first, and documented.
texte.L'intervention humaine est-elle réelle,: Is human intervention real, competent and documented?
texte.L'obligation de retracer un lot en amont: The obligation to trace a batch upstream and downstream applies whatever the tool. An AI system that decides on a downgrade must leave a trace that can be reconstructed.

Technical context: EU AI Act Reg. #/#, # risk levels (unacceptable, high, limited, minimal), # Annex III areas.

Features: mapping of # jurisdictions, #-step AI Act compliance simulator, #-point audit, jurisdiction comparator, geopolitical analysis, official texts, article-by-article obligations.
texte.L'utilisateur realise l'Audit de conform: The user is carrying out the AI Act compliance audit (# checkpoints, # sections). Sections: Art. # prohibited practices (# pts), Art. # high-risk classification (# pts), Art. #-# risk and data management (# pts), Art. #-#-# documentation and logs (# pts), Art. #-# transparency and oversight (# pts), Art. #-# robustness and quality (# pts), Art. #-# assessment and registration (# pts), GPAI Art. #-# (# pts). # statuses: Compliant (green), In progress (orange), To be done (red). Score in % and PDF export.

Data: EU (severity #, innovation #), US (severity #, innovation #), SG (severity #, innovation #), CH (severity #, innovation #).
